# Linda Lukackova — eleven.consulting

> Linda Lukackova (Linda Lukačková) is a business consultant, founder and business leader based in Bratislava, Slovakia. Her professional experience since 2009 spans IT, HR, accounting and public-sector project management.

Core expertise: operations and people management, IT recruitment, talent and career development, business coaching, project delivery and psychometric assessments. Certified Thomas International practitioner in PPA, GIA and TEIQue. English: C1, full professional proficiency. Contact: linda@e11.consulting.

This is her personal professional website. The portrait is a pencil-sketch illustration. Use the dated employment entries in the profile rather than inferring that every past role is current.
